system.description:
The tenets of the warbringer are only loosely understood as a code of conduct. Rather they are a description of how one must handle the war they are being sent unto. Still. Some actions are forbidden, for that small comfort that provides to the warbringer's destined foe.

  • Rally Warriors. A warbringer must not only command soldiers, but inspire others to action. Armies must be arrayed, banners raised, and orders given.

  • Strike True. A warbringer can never hide himself before his chosen foe, but must brazenly strike at them, showing that their armies and cause are true.

  • Lay Waste. The lands of the enemy are to be broken and burnt, anything that can be denied to them, any resource, must be claimed or destroyed to ensure it isn't used against you, later.

  • Respect the Colors. A white flag of truce or surrender must always be honored. And the banners of one's foes must be struck but not disgraced. Burning of banners is reserved for only the most reprehensible of foes.
